documents.text: 1938 ( 1938-01-04 ) ( aged 55 ) Busselton , Western Australia Political party Nationalist Edmund Vernon Brockman ( 28 April 1882 – 4 January 1938 ) was an Australian politician who was a Nationalist Party member of the Legislative Assembly of Western Australia from 1933 until his death , representing the seat of Sussex . Brockman was born in Pemberton , in Western Australia 's South West region , to Capel Carter ( née Bussell ) and Edward Reveley Brockman .
